newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Clabecq suspended pending court decision.
newsitem.headline: Clabecq suspended pending court decision.

text.p: Trading in troubled Belgian steel maker Forges de Clabecq will remain suspended until a commercial court takes a final decision on whether to declare the company bankrupt, a Brussels bourse official said on Friday.
"We'll wait for the final decision of the court. In the meantime, Clabecq remains suspended," the bourse official told Reuters.
The commercial court in the southern Belgian town of Nivelles has ruled against declaring Clabecq and has instead appointed two experts, who have to submit a first report to the court on December 24.
Clabecq filed for bankruptcy on Thursday after its majority shareholder, Belgium's southern Walloon region, decided to withdraw its support.
"If the court had decided to declare Clabecq bankrupt, we would immediately have delisted it," the official said.
The fate of the loss-making steel firm, which employs 1,700 people, appeared to have been sealed on Wednesday when the European Commission rejected a rescue plan by the Walloon region for Clabecq.
